blocks.prompt: 12. In how many ways can 6 keys be arranged in a circular key ring?
blocks.explanation:
Keys chhalle (ring) par gol daire mein lagti hain, aur chhalle ko ulta bhi kiya ja sakta hai.
Plan: yeh woh gol tarteeb hai jis mein clockwise aur anticlockwise ek hi maani jati hai (Case-II). Pehle Case-I ki tarah ginenge, phir 2 se divide karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 6 mukhtalif keys ek gol key ring par.
Humein find karna hai: keys ring par kitni mukhtalif tarteebon mein lag sakti hain.
Tareeqa: Case-II: \(\dfrac{(n - 1)!}{2}\), kyunke ring ko palatne se clockwise tarteeb anticlockwise ban jati hai, lekin ring wahi rehti hai.

Gol tarteeb
\[(6 - 1)! = 5! = 120\]
Kyun: Ring ko ghumane se keys ki tarteeb nahi badalti, is liye ek key ko fix kar ke baaqi 5 ko arrange kiya. Yeh abhi Case-I wala jawab hai; ring ki khaas baat (palatna) agle qadam mein aayegi.

Ring palatne ka asar
\[\dfrac{5!}{2} = \dfrac{120}{2} = 60\]
Kyun: Ring ko haath mein le kar ulta kar dein to wahi keys ulti tarteeb mein nazar aati hain, magar ring to wahi hai. Is tarah har tarteeb aur us ki ulti tarteeb do dafa gini gayi thi, is liye 2 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: Log mez par bethe hon to palta nahi ja sakta (Case-I), lekin key ring, haar (necklace) aur kangan palte ja sakte hain (Case-II).

Tasdeeq
\[\text{necklace of 6 beads (Question 13)} = 60\]
Kyun: Key ring aur haar ka hisaab bilkul ek jaisa hai; Sawal 13 mein 6 daano ka jawab bhi 60 hai. Computer se 6 cheezon ki gol tarteebein (ghumane aur palatne ko ek maan kar) gini gayin to bhi 60 aayin.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein \(3\) likha hai. Yeh \(\dfrac{(4 - 1)!}{2}\) hai, yani sirf 4 keys ka jawab. 6 keys ke liye sahi jawab \(\dfrac{(6 - 1)!}{2} = 60\) hai, bilkul Sawal 13 (6 daane) jaisa, jis ka jawab key mein 60 hi diya gaya hai.
